sample.bsb: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
sample.web: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
sample.kjv: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
sample.heb: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא־ יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־ חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת׃

sample.bsb: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.
sample.web: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
sample.kjv: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
sample.heb: יָפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֤ן בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃

sample.bsb: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
sample.web: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
sample.kjv: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
sample.heb: הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל־ חֵילָ֑ם וּבְרֹ֥ב עָ֝שְׁרָ֗ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃

sample.bsb: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
sample.web: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
sample.kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
sample.heb: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כָל־ מוֹעֲדֵי־ אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

sample.bsb: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
sample.web: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
sample.kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
sample.heb: יִ֭בְצֹר ר֣וּחַ נְגִידִ֑ים נ֝וֹרָ֗א לְמַלְכֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃

sample.bsb: Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.
sample.web: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
sample.kjv: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
sample.heb: וְלֹא־ נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃

sample.bsb: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
sample.web: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
sample.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
sample.heb: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

sample.bsb: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
sample.web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
sample.kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
sample.heb: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל־ עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃

sample.bsb: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
sample.web: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
sample.kjv: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
sample.heb: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃

sample.bsb: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
sample.web: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
sample.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
sample.heb: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־ שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

sample.bsb: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
sample.web: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
sample.kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
sample.heb: מֵ֭אֹ֣יְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֹתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא־ לִֽי׃

sample.bsb: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
sample.web: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
sample.kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
sample.heb: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃

sample.bsb: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
sample.web: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
sample.kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
sample.heb: סָמַ֣ר מִפַּחְדְּךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י וּֽמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ יָרֵֽאתִי׃

sample.bsb: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
sample.web: To him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;
sample.kjv: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
sample.heb: לְגֹזֵ֣ר יַם־ ס֭וּף לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

sample.bsb: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
sample.web: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
sample.kjv: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
sample.heb: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃

sample.bsb: Do not tell your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I will provide”— when you already have the means.
sample.web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
sample.kjv: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
sample.heb: אַל־ תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לְרֵֽעֲךָ֨ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃

sample.bsb: winking his eyes, speaking with his feet, and pointing with his fingers.
sample.web: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers;
sample.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
sample.heb: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭עֵינָיו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֑יו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃

sample.bsb: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
sample.web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
sample.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
sample.heb: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭בָּא אֶל־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כָּֽל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽהּ׃

sample.bsb: Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
sample.web: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
sample.kjv: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
sample.heb: הֲלֹֽא־ חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃

sample.bsb: A wise man fears and turns from evil, but a fool is careless and reckless.
sample.web: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
sample.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
sample.heb: חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ׃

sample.bsb: Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred.
sample.web: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
sample.kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
sample.heb: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה־ שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה־ בֽוֹ׃

sample.bsb: for it is pleasing when you keep them within you and they are constantly on your lips.
sample.web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
sample.kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
sample.heb: כִּֽי־ נָ֭עִים כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל־ שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃

sample.bsb: Do not envy wicked men or desire their company;
sample.web: Don’t be envious of evil men; neither desire to be with them:
sample.kjv: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
sample.heb: אַל־ תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י רָעָ֑ה וְאַל־ תִּ֝תְאָ֗יו לִהְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽם׃

sample.bsb: through knowledge its rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure.
sample.web: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
sample.kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
sample.heb: וּ֭בְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל־ ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים׃

sample.bsb: A foolish scheme is sin, and a mocker is detestable to men.
sample.web: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
sample.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
sample.heb: זִמַּ֣ת אִוֶּ֣לֶת חַטָּ֑את וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְאָדָ֣ם לֵֽץ׃

sample.bsb: While my soul was still searching but not finding, among a thousand I have found one upright man, but among all these I have not found one such woman.
sample.web: which my soul still seeks; but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand; but I have not found a woman among all those.
sample.kjv: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
sample.heb: אֲשֶׁ֛ר עוֹד־ בִּקְשָׁ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י וְלֹ֣א מָצָ֑אתִי אָדָ֞ם אֶחָ֤ד מֵאֶ֙לֶף֙ מָצָ֔אתִי וְאִשָּׁ֥ה בְכָל־ אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֥א מָצָֽאתִי׃

sample.bsb: They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the sea is full of water.
sample.web: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.
sample.kjv: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
sample.heb: לֹֽא־ יָרֵ֥עוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁחִ֖יתוּ בְּכָל־ הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑י כִּֽי־ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים׃ פ

sample.bsb: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known in all the earth.
sample.web: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
sample.kjv: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
sample.heb: זַמְּר֣וּ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י גֵא֖וּת עָשָׂ֑ה מוּדַ֥עַת זֹ֖את בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

sample.bsb: You have enlarged the nation, O LORD; You have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for Yourself; You have extended all the borders of the land.
sample.web: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
sample.kjv: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
sample.heb: יָסַ֤פְתָּ לַגּוֹי֙ יְהוָ֔ה יָסַ֥פְתָּ לַגּ֖וֹי נִכְבָּ֑דְתָּ רִחַ֖קְתָּ כָּל־ קַצְוֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃

sample.bsb: I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.
sample.web: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
sample.kjv: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
sample.heb: חֵמָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לִ֑י מִֽי־ יִתְּנֵ֜נִי שָׁמִ֥יר שַׁ֙יִת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶפְשְׂעָ֥ה בָ֖הּ אֲצִיתֶ֥נָּה יָּֽחַד׃

sample.bsb: They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us the truth! Speak to us pleasant words; prophesy illusions.
sample.web: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and to the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
sample.kjv: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
sample.heb: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמְר֤וּ לָֽרֹאִים֙ לֹ֣א תִרְא֔וּ וְלַ֣חֹזִ֔ים לֹ֥א תֶחֱזוּ־ לָ֖נוּ נְכֹח֑וֹת דַּבְּרוּ־ לָ֣נוּ חֲלָק֔וֹת חֲז֖וּ מַהֲתַלּֽוֹת׃

sample.bsb: Like birds hovering overhead, so the LORD of Hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will shield it and deliver it; He will pass over it and preserve it.”
sample.web: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”
sample.kjv: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
sample.heb: כְּצִפֳּרִ֣ים עָפ֔וֹת כֵּ֗ן יָגֵ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם גָּנ֥וֹן וְהִצִּ֖יל פָּסֹ֥חַ וְהִמְלִֽיט׃

sample.bsb: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines,
sample.web: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
sample.kjv: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
sample.heb: עַל־ שָׁדַ֖יִם סֹֽפְדִ֑ים עַל־ שְׂדֵי־ חֶ֕מֶד עַל־ גֶּ֖פֶן פֹּרִיָּֽה׃

sample.bsb: What can I say? He has spoken to me, and He Himself has done this. I will walk slowly all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
sample.web: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
sample.kjv: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
sample.heb: מָֽה־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר וְאָֽמַר־ לִ֖י וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑ה אֶדַּדֶּ֥ה כָל־ שְׁנוֹתַ֖י עַל־ מַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃

sample.bsb: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all humanity together will see it. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.”
sample.web: Yahweh’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
sample.kjv: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
sample.heb: וְנִגְלָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה וְרָא֤וּ כָל־ בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ ס

sample.bsb: You will seek them but will not find them. Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.
sample.web: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a non-existent thing.
sample.kjv: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
sample.heb: תְּבַקְשֵׁם֙ וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָאֵ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֖י מַצֻּתֶ֑ךָ יִהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וּכְאֶ֖פֶס אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחַמְתֶּֽךָ׃

sample.bsb: Let the desert and its cities raise their voices; let the villages of Kedar cry aloud. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them cry out from the mountaintops.
sample.web: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!
sample.kjv: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
sample.heb: יִשְׂא֤וּ מִדְבָּר֙ וְעָרָ֔יו חֲצֵרִ֖ים תֵּשֵׁ֣ב קֵדָ֑ר יָרֹ֙נּוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי סֶ֔לַע מֵרֹ֥אשׁ הָרִ֖ים יִצְוָֽחוּ׃

sample.bsb: By Myself I have sworn; truth has gone out from My mouth, a word that will not be revoked: Every knee will bow before Me, every tongue will swear allegiance.
sample.web: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.
sample.kjv: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

sample.web: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
sample.kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
sample.grk: ἔπειτα ἦλθον εἰς τὰ κλίματα τῆς Συρίας καὶ τῆς Κιλικίας.

sample.bsb: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?
sample.web: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
sample.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
sample.grk: ὁ οὖν ἐπιχορηγῶν ὑμῖν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἐνεργῶν δυνάμεις ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως;

sample.bsb: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
sample.web: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
sample.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
sample.grk: ὥστε ὁ νόμος παιδαγωγὸς ἡμῶν γέγονεν εἰς Χριστόν, ἵνα ἐκ πίστεως δικαιωθῶμεν·

sample.bsb: My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
sample.web: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
sample.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
sample.grk: τέκνα μου, οὓς πάλιν ὠδίνω μέχρις οὗ μορφωθῇ Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν·

sample.bsb: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.
sample.web: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
sample.kjv: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
sample.grk: εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ,

sample.bsb: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
sample.web: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;
sample.kjv: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
sample.grk: ἀποθέσθαι ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὴν προτέραν ἀναστροφὴν τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν φθειρόμενον κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ἀπάτης,

sample.bsb: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.
sample.web: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule. Let us be of the same mind.
sample.kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
sample.grk: πλὴν εἰς ὃ ἐφθάσαμεν, τῷ αὐτῷ στοιχεῖν.

sample.bsb: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
sample.web: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
sample.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
sample.grk: εἴ γε ἐπιμένετε τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε, τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν, οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος.

sample.bsb: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
sample.web: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
sample.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
sample.grk: εἰ γὰρ καὶ τῇ σαρκὶ ἄπειμι, ἀλλὰ τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι, χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν.

sample.bsb: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as the true word of God—the word which is now at work in you who believe.
sample.web: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.
sample.kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
sample.grk: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ θεῷ ἀδιαλείπτως, ὅτι παραλαβόντες λόγον ἀκοῆς παρʼ ἡμῶν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐδέξασθε οὐ λόγον ἀνθρώπων ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἀληθῶς ἐστὶν λόγον θεοῦ, ὃς καὶ ἐνεργεῖται ἐν ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν.

sample.bsb: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
sample.web: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love, and into the perseverance of Christ.
sample.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
sample.grk: ὁ δὲ κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν ὑπομονὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

sample.bsb: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
sample.web: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
sample.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
sample.grk: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ διαλογισμοῦ.

sample.bsb: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
sample.web: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
sample.kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
sample.grk: Οἱ καλῶς προεστῶτες πρεσβύτεροι διπλῆς τιμῆς ἀξιούσθωσαν, μάλιστα οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ·

sample.bsb: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
sample.web: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service, and an earthly sanctuary.
sample.kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
sample.grk: Εἶχε μὲν οὖν ἡ πρώτη δικαιώματα λατρείας τό τε ἅγιον κοσμικόν.

sample.bsb: That is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.
sample.web: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
sample.kjv: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
sample.grk: ὅθεν οὐδὲ ἡ πρώτη χωρὶς αἵματος ἐγκεκαίνισται·

sample.bsb: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,
sample.web: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
sample.kjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
sample.grk: λαληθείσης γὰρ πάσης ἐντολῆς κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑπὸ Μωϋσέως παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, λαβὼν τὸ αἷμα τῶν μόσχων μετὰ ὕδατος καὶ ἐρίου κοκκίνου καὶ ὑσσώπου αὐτό τε τὸ βιβλίον καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν ἐράντισεν,

sample.bsb: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
sample.web: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
sample.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
sample.grk: τίμιος ὁ γάμος ἐν πᾶσιν καὶ ἡ κοίτη ἀμίαντος, πόρνους γὰρ καὶ μοιχοὺς κρινεῖ ὁ θεός.

sample.bsb: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
sample.web: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
sample.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
sample.grk: νῦν δὲ καυχᾶσθε ἐν ταῖς ἀλαζονείαις ὑμῶν· πᾶσα καύχησις τοιαύτη πονηρά ἐστιν.

sample.bsb: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
sample.web: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
sample.kjv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
sample.grk: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ, ὡς λογίζομαι, διʼ ὀλίγων ἔγραψα, παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰς ἣν στῆτε.

sample.bsb: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
sample.web: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
sample.kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
sample.grk: καὶ ταῦτα γράφομεν ἡμεῖς ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.

sample.bsb: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
sample.web: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
sample.kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
sample.grk: γίνου γρηγορῶν, καὶ στήρισον τὰ λοιπὰ ἃ ἔμελλον ἀποθανεῖν, οὐ γὰρ εὕρηκά σου τὰ ἔργα πεπληρωμένα ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ μου·

sample.bsb: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
sample.web: And behold, a pale horse, and he who sat on it, his name was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
sample.kjv: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
sample.grk: καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος χλωρός, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ὄνομα αὐτῷ ὁ Θάνατος, καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἠκολούθει μετʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἐξουσία ἐπὶ τὸ τέταρτον τῆς γῆς, ἀποκτεῖναι ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν θηρίων τῆς γῆς.

sample.bsb: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
sample.web: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David; the Bright and Morning Star.”
sample.kjv: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
sample.grk: Ἐγὼ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεμψα τὸν ἄγγελόν μου μαρτυρῆσαι ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐπὶ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ῥίζα καὶ τὸ γένος Δαυίδ, ὁ ἀστὴρ ὁ λαμπρός, ὁ πρωϊνός.
